names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 aprilie, «Sfânta Cuvioasă Maria Egipteanca».

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 1 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Св. Марија Египћанка“, with Св. left off, which is not a rank. Египћанка is kept: it is not a rank but the by-name the heading gives her, the Egyptian, and it is what this folder's English name already carries. A bare Марија would stand against `mary-called-marinos`, `mary-of-tarsus` and `mary-wife-of-xenophon`, which hold that form.

death.note: The year printed beside her name on days.pravoslavie.ru for 1 April (old style).

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Марии Египетской (522)»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 aprilie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Maria Egipteanca»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Απριλίου — «Οσία Μαρία η Αιγυπτία»

attestations.note: The life page, https://www.saint.gr/156/saint.aspx, has its own «Ημερομηνία Εορτής» of 1 Απριλίου and «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», so this is her fixed day and not the moveable one. Its last line before the hymns is «Η Εκκλησία τιμά την μνήμη της Οσίας Μαρίας της Αιγυπτίας και την Ε' Κυριακή των Νηστειών» — the Church honours her also on the Fifth Sunday of Lent, which is reckoned from Pascha and which the schema cannot hold; it is recorded here and nowhere else. The page names Sophronius patriarch of Jerusalem (11 Μαρτίου) as the author of her life and quotes him throughout, and it puts her «κατά τους χρόνους του αυτοκράτορα Ιουστινιανού (527 - 565 μ.Χ.)». **That disagrees with this folder's recorded death of 522**, which was read off days.pravoslavie.ru; the reign saint.gr names begins five years after it. The existing date is left exactly as it stands — a reign is not a year and this reading does not overturn a source already cited — and the disagreement is recorded in the reader's report. The page also prints the distich «Ἀπῆρε πνεῦμα, σάρξ ἀπερρύη πάλαι. / Τὸν ὅστινον γῆ κρύπτε νεκρὸν Μαρίας» and the hexameter «Πρώτῃ Ἀπριλίου Μαρίη θάνεν εὖχος ἐρήμου», which names this day.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.04.2026 (1. април ст. ст.) — „Св. Марија Египћанка“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day all three other calendars already keep in this folder, and the same life, named to the same author — Sophronius patriarch of Jerusalem — and told through the same elder Zosimas. **Three numbers in it disagree with what this folder and its other sources hold, and not one of them was acted on.** The entry puts her in Alexandria and gives seventeen full years of profligacy from her twelfth year, where saint.gr says only Egypt and uses seventeen for the first seventeen years of her struggle beyond the Jordan; it gives forty-eight years in the desert where saint.gr gives forty-seven; and it ends „Упокојила се око 530 год.“, about 530, where this folder holds a precise 522 from days.pravoslavie.ru's line. 530 falls outside that year, so **the sourced date stands and the disagreement is recorded here and in the life**. New to the folder besides those: the three loaves she bought, the communion at the monastery of St John before she crossed, the glance at the icon of the Theotokos in the narthex and the promise made before it, that she crossed the Jordan walking on the water after signing it with the cross, that Zosimas saw her raised up in the air at prayer, and that he learned her name only from the words written in the sand above her head, which also say she died on 1 April in the very night of Christ's saving passion after communicating. **The Prologue has no lion**: Zosimas buries her himself where the Romanian and the Greek lives both have the beast dig the grave. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; this folder's two hymns are the Romanian's and the Greek's. The stored form Марија Египћанка keeps the by-name the heading gives it, Египћанка, the Egyptian, which is not a rank and is what this folder's English name already carries; a bare Марија would fold with the three folders that hold one.

hymns.text: Întru tine maică cu osârdie s-a mântuit cel după chip; că luând crucea ai urmat lui Hristos; și lucrând ai învățat să nu se uite la trup, că este trecător; ci să poarte grijă de suflet, de lucrul cel nemuritor. Pentru aceasta și cu îngerii împreună se bucură, cuvioasă Marie, duhul tău.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfintei Cuvioase Maria Egipteanca (the page prints no glas)

english.text: In thee, O mother, that which was made after the image was kept safe with care; for taking up the cross thou didst follow Christ, and by thy labour thou didst teach men to overlook the flesh, since it passes away, and to take thought for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore, O venerable Mary, thy spirit rejoices together with the angels.

hymns.text: Φωτισθεῖσα ἐνθέως Σταυροῦ τὴ χάριτι, τῆς μετανοίας ἐδείχθης φωτοφανῆς λαμπηδών, τῶν παθῶν τὸν σκοτασμὸν λιποῦσα πάνσεμνε, ὅθεν ὡς ἄγγελος Θεοῦ, Ζωσιμᾶ τῷ ἱερῷ, ὠράθης ἐν τὴ ἐρήμω, Μαρία «Ὅσιε Μῆτερ» μεθ' οὐ δυσώπει ὑπὲρ πάντων ἠμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον, on her own page. It names her and names Zosimas. The page prints besides it a second apolytikion, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, «Ἐν σοί Μῆτερ ἀκριβῶς διεσώθη τό κατ᾽ εἰκόνα», which is the common of a venerable woman with her name in its last line; and a heading «Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ'. Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον» under which no text at all is printed, so no kontakion could be taken. The readings «τὴ χάριτι», «ἐν τὴ ἐρήμω» and «μεθ' οὐ» for τῇ, τῇ and μεθ' οὗ are the page's own and are left as printed.

english.text: Enlightened by God through the grace of the Cross, thou wast shown to be a bright-shining lamp of repentance, O all-honoured one, having left behind the darkness of the passions; whence thou wast seen in the desert by the holy Zosimas as an angel of God. O Mary, venerable Mother, together with him entreat for us all.
